reconstructed_captions.52: The freshly baked pizza is slid from the peel onto a wooden cutting board.
reconstructed_captions.53: A hand picks up a round, stainless steel pizza cutter with a black handle.
reconstructed_captions.54: The pizza cutter is pressed firmly onto the crust and rolled across the center of the pizza.
reconstructed_captions.55: The cutter makes another slice, perpendicular to the first, to divide the pizza into quarters.
reconstructed_captions.56: The pizza is cut several more times, creating eight even triangular slices.
reconstructed_captions.57: A hand reaches in and carefully lifts one hot, cheesy slice of pizza from the board.
